```
COLLECTIONS CHECK · Maple & Sons Plumbing

You will need
• Mobile phone with bank app installed
• Invoice folder (location: ASK OWNER)
• Customer phone numbers
• Text messaging

Steps
1. Open your bank app on Friday afternoon.
2. Go through the list of payments received and note who has not paid.
3. Open your invoice folder and identify invoices unpaid for 3+ weeks.
4. Text each customer: "Hi, just checking in on that invoice for [amount/date]. Let me know if you have questions."
5. Record the date you texted each customer (note: ASK OWNER how to log this).
6. Check for replies over the following week.
7. Repeat next Friday.

Done looks like
• You have texted every customer with a 3+ week unpaid invoice.
• You have a record of who you texted and when.
• You follow up only on invoices you confirmed are unpaid, not guesses.

Common mistakes to watch for
1. **Forgetting between Fridays.** Without a log, you lose track of who you texted. Check: write down the customer name and date immediately after sending.
2. **Missing the 90-day crisis.** By checking only weekly, invoices slip to 90+ days before you notice (and you only spot them when you need cash). Check: ASK OWNER whether you want a mid-week reminder or a weekly report sorted by invoice age.
3. **Texting customers who already paid.** If you open the invoice folder before checking the bank app, you may text people who paid but the folder hasn't updated. Check: always open the bank app first, use it as your source of truth.

---
**Draft ready.** Owner to send, sign, or delete. If steps need detail, export this, open in Brain Surgeon (VS Code button), and ask it to test the procedure against your real invoices.
```
